senses.gloss:
1. कुप् कुप्, i. 4, Par. Ātm.
 1. To become excited, Suśr. 2, 184, 11.
 2. To be angry, Man. 3, 229. With dat. gen. and acc., Of the person with whom one is angry, Pañc. 23, 22; Rām. 4, 19, 24; 1, 49, 7.
 कुपित, Enraged, Man. 9, 313. With उपरि and gen. (enraged against us), Pañc. 73, 15.
 अ-कुप्य, adj. Not liable to become angry, MBh. 15, 821.
 --Caus. कोपय,
 1. To excite, Suśr. 2, 204, 3.
 2. To provoke, MBh. 2, 2140. Ātm. To provoke against one's own self, MBh. 2, 2187. Anomalous कोपयीत for कोपयेत, कोपिष्ठास् for चूकुपथास्, कोपयान for कोपयमान, MBh. 1, 5790; 2, 2188; 3, 1956.
 3. To be angry, Bhāg. P. 4, 5, 11.
 --With the prep. परि परि,
 1. To be much excited, MBh. 1, 1186.
 2. To be very angry, MBh. 13, 2101.
 --Caus.
 1. To excite violently, MBh. 14, 469.
 2. To provoke violently, MBh. 13, 7403.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To become agitated, Suśr. 2, 396, 4; MBh. 13, 14508.
 प्रकुपित, Very angry, Pañc. 163, 5.
 नातिप्रकुपित, Rather indifferent, [] Daśak. in Chr. 194, 11. Anomalous प्रकुप्त, Vikr. d. 130.
 --Caus.
 1. To excite, MBh. 14, 465.
 2. To provoke, Man. 9, 313.
 --With सम् सम्, To become angry, MBh. 3, 1093.
 --Caus. To provoke, MBh. 4, 1845.
 --Cf. Lat. cupio = कुप्यामि.
† 2. कुप् कुप्, i. 10, Par. To speak or shine.
† कूप् कूप्, i. 10, Par. To be weak.

कुप्य कुप् + य,
 I. n. (and ऽकुप्यक -कुप्य + क as latter part of a comp.), Any metal except gold and silver, Man. 7, 96.
 II. m. A proper name, Rājat. 6, 264.

कूप कूप, m.
 1. A pit, MBh. 1, 716.
 2. A well, Man. 4, 202.
 --Comp.
कूपकार कूप-कार, m. A welldigger, Rām. 2, 80, 3.
कूप- + दर्दुर कूप- + दर्दुर, m. A frog living in a well, Pañc. i. d. 21.

कु- + पट कु- + पट,
 I. m. and n. a plain garment, Bhāg. P. 5, 9, 11.
 II. m. the name of a Dānava or demon, MBh. 1, 2534.
कु- + पितृ कु- + पितृ, m. a wicked father.
कूप- + मण्डूक कूप- + मण्डूक, m. a frog in a well, applied to a person of no enterprise, one who never leaves his home, Hit. 82, 2.
